routes.label: Count the partition and complete the square

question: Use 36 m of fencing to enclose a rectangular livestock pen, with a fence through the middle parallel to the width dividing it into two smaller rectangles (the total fence length includes the partition). Find the maximum area of the pen. (Unit: \(\mathrm{m}^2\))
solution:
Let the width be \(x\ \mathrm{m}\). The fencing includes two lengths and three widths, so the length is \((36-3x)/2\ \mathrm{m}\), with \(0<x<12\). Thus the area is
\[
S=x(36-3x)/2=-1.5(x-6)^2+54.
\]
Since \((x-6)^2\ge0\), the maximum area is \(54\ \mathrm{m}^2\), attained when \(x=6\) and the length is \(9\ \mathrm{m}\).
